angles: The paradigm shift: Cursor mobile app redefines the developer role from 'keyboard operator' to 'agent supervisor' — the phone form factor enforces this distinction better than desktop ever could
SpaceX acquisition context: $60B bet on agentic coding market — what it means for Cursor's future, data privacy, and model routing (still Claude/GPT/Composer for now, but Grok integration coming)
Mobile-first agent management: Cursor is the first major tool to build a product experience explicitly designed for mobile supervision rather than treating mobile as an afterthought
Human-in-the-loop is the dominant pattern: Anthropic report confirms 0-20% full delegation — the mobile app makes oversight practical from anywhere
Enterprise concerns: cloud-only agent architecture creates data residency headaches; Remote Control requires admin enablement in Enterprise plans
Competitive landscape: Cursor iOS app vs GitHub Copilot App (parallel agents, worktrees) vs Claude Code — who owns the mobile agent management space?
